rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Headless IDA MCP Server provides remote binary analysis capabilities through IDA Pro's headless mode, exposing powerful reverse engineering tools via the Model Context Protocol. Built upon work from mrexodia's ida-pro-mcp and DennyDai's headless-ida library, this server enables AI agents to programmatically analyze binaries, decompile functions, manipulate code elements, and extract critical information from executable files. The implementation includes tools for function management, disassembly, decompilation, cross-reference analysis, and code annotation, making it valuable for security researchers and reverse engineers who want to integrate automated binary analysis into their AI-powered workflows.
